answer: The vertex counter is kept in relic and plume reveals each reset. Someone therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1489 identities would post 2850 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
